findings.title: Every token alias resolves
findings.summary: A token that points to nothing renders as nothing. The CSS this library was migrated from had exactly this bug.
findings.fix: Repoint or delete the alias before publishing.

findings.title: Nothing marked for removal is still published
findings.summary: The file's own note says to remove department colours. 4 of those tokens are still there, 4 layers still bind them and 24 variants are still named after departments. Anything an AI tool can see, it will use again.
evidence: tokens: dept/digital, dept/mortgages, dept/products, dept/talent
layers still bound, by component: SectionTag (4)
department variants, by component: Avatar (16), SectionTag (4), Stat Card (4)
findings.fix: Move to the deprecated list with a removal date, migrate the consumers shown here, then delete.

findings.title: No colour inside a component comes from outside the palette
findings.summary: A colour that exists in no token cannot be themed, cannot switch to dark mode and cannot be traced to a decision.
evidence: colours: none
components: none
findings.fix: Bind to an existing token, or propose a new token through the gate.

findings.title: Every token has its own name in code
findings.summary: Two tokens that export to the same CSS property silently overwrite each other in code.
findings.fix: Give each token a unique code name before the export runs.

findings.title: Every colour is bound to a token or a style
findings.summary: 75 of 1928 visible solid paints are typed in by hand. 49 of them use 13 colours that exist in no token.
evidence: split: documentation and internal pages (73), inside components (2)

where: page: Colour (46), page: Overview (20), page: Iconography (3), page: Spacing, Grid & Layout (1), page: Radius & Elevation (1), page: Tone of Voice (1), page: Photography (1), component: Key Stakeholders Card (1), component: Overview Card (1)
off-palette colours: #D9D9D9 (30), #FF0000 (8), #E78F94 (1), #F0D3D5 (1), #DBB2FB (1), #E4C9F9 (1), #B4DEF2 (1), #CAE6F3 (1), #D2CFCC (1), #DEDBDA (1), #FC0E0E (1), #F2F2F2 (1)
findings.fix: Bind in bulk; what cannot be bound is a missing token or a mistake.

findings.title: Every token is used by a component
findings.summary: Of 254 tokens, 21 are bound by nothing at all, and 7 more are used only by their own swatch on a documentation page, never by a component.
evidence: bound by nothing, by group: size (12), status (4), component (4), text (1)

names: component/avatar/font-xl, component/combobox/max-width, component/dropzone/icon, component/tabs/gap, size/col-1, size/col-2, size/col-3, size/col-4, size/col-5, size/col-6, size/container, size/container-half, size/full-width, size/icon-body, size/icon-md, size/icon-sm, status/error-border, status/info-border, status/success-border, status/warning-border, text/link
documentation-only, by group: neutral (4), space (2), brand (1)
names: brand/grey, neutral/0, neutral/300, neutral/650, neutral/950, space/lg, space/none
findings.fix: Delete, or record why it is kept (for example: reference-only values behind a gradient style).

findings.title: The library carries nothing from other libraries
findings.summary: 0 variables from 0 other library files are still attached to this file (0 layers use them). They are invisible in the Figma UI, which is why nobody removed them.
findings.fix: Detach. A source of truth should not depend on files nobody can name.

findings.title: Deleted tokens are really gone
findings.summary: Tokens deleted in the UI but still stored in the file.
findings.fix: Re-save after cleanup; verify on the next snapshot.

findings.title: Every text layer uses a text style
findings.summary: 42 of 919 text layers have no text style, in 7 different sizes.
evidence: where: Avatar (20), Overview (6), Jira Annotation (5), Colour (2), Key Stakeholders Card (2), Overview Card (2), Spacing, Grid & Layout (1), Radius & Elevation (1), Iconography (1), Tone of Voice (1), Photography (1)
findings.fix: Apply the nearest style; a size with no style is a missing role or drift.

findings.title: No two text styles say the same thing
findings.summary: 18 text styles in the file; 0 groups are identical in font, weight, size, line height and tracking.
findings.fix: Keep one, remap the others, delete.

findings.title: Every shadow uses an elevation style
findings.summary: 0 of 39 layers with effects do not use an effect style.
findings.fix: Apply Elevation/* or remove.

findings.title: Components bind semantic tokens, never raw primitives
findings.summary: The file's own rule: primitives are private, components bind the semantic layer. Where a component skips it, light/dark switching breaks.
evidence: components: Overview Card (27), Footer (22), Navigation Bar (22), Team Card (12), SectionTag (4), Key Stakeholders Card (3)
primitives: brand/white (35), brand/milkyway (35), brand/midnight (11), neutral/850 (5), dept/digital (1), dept/talent (1), dept/mortgages (1), dept/products (1)
findings.fix: Rebind to the semantic token; if none fits, that is a missing semantic role.

findings.title: Every token names its code equivalent
findings.summary: The file says 'every variable carries a code syntax entry'. 19 of 254 do not.
evidence: component/annotation/body-gap, component/annotation/body-padding-v, component/annotation/gap-header, component/annotation/padding-badges-bottom, component/annotation/padding-badges-top, component/annotation/padding-bottom-header, component/annotation/padding-h, component/annotation/padding-v, component/group-card/body-gap-h, component/group-card/body-gap-v, component/group-card/gap, component/group-card/padding-h, component/group-card/padding-v, component/overview/actions-gap, component/overview/body-padding, component/overview/head-padding, component/overview/padding-h, component/overview/padding-v, text/access-muted
findings.fix: Generate the code name from the token name in the export step.

findings.title: Every component says when to use it
findings.summary: A component with no description gives an AI tool nothing to decide with.
findings.fix: Write the 'use when / do not use when' line; the contract is generated from it.

findings.title: The documentation matches the file
findings.summary: Numbers the library states about itself, compared with what is actually in it. Hand-written documentation goes stale the day after it is written.
evidence: Component variables: page says 35, file has 125
Dimension variables: page says 39, file has 43
Semantic variables: page says 36, file has 39
findings.fix: Stop writing these by hand: generate the overview and the changelog from the snapshot diff.

findings.title: Uppercase labels: rule or exception?
findings.summary: 46 text layers are typed in capitals. The file documents this as intentional for UI/Tag and UI/Eyebrow; the audit calls it against the typography rule. Both cannot be right.
evidence: where: Dashboard shell (7), Stat Card (6), Footer (6), SectionTag (4), Page rhythm (4), Section / Showcase (4), Table (4), Table Row (4), Search and results (4), Code Block (1), Modal (1), Jira Annotation (1)
styles: UI/Tag (37), UI/Eyebrow (9)
findings.fix: Decide once, write it in governance.json, and the check enforces whichever answer you choose.

findings.title: Components over the variant budget (12)
findings.summary: 243 variants across 41 component sets. The audit says 'probably half can go'. This lists each set with its axes, so the cut is a decision per axis, not a redesign.
evidence: Button: 24 = Style(3) x Variant(2) x State(4)
Avatar: 20 = Size(4) x Fill(5)
Progress Bar: 16 = Size(4) x Tone(4)
Badge: 14 = Tone(7) x Dot(2)
Input: 10 = Type(2) x State(5)
Form Field: 10 = Type(2) x State(5)
Checkbox: 9 = Checked(3) x State(3)
Search Bar: 8 = Size(2) x State(4)
Select: 8 = Value(2) x State(4)
Section / Full Width: 8 = Layout(4) x Variant(2)
Radio: 6 = Checked(2) x State(3)
Toggle: 6 = On(2) x State(3)
findings.fix: Set the budget in governance.json; the gate then stops a set from growing past it.

findings.title: 'Danger' and 'Error' name the same thing
findings.summary: Two words for one meaning across components. An AI tool has no way to know they are the same.
evidence: Danger: Menu Item
Error: Alert, Badge, File Uploader, Form Field, Input, Progress Bar, Search Bar, Select, Toast
findings.fix: Choose one word; record the other as a forbidden alias in the contract.
